The '''Danju system''' was a star system in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], just outside the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Freeworlds Territory]]. It contained the planet [[Lammax]] that was near a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]. [[Lamuu Bianco]] established a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] on Lammax called [[Port Bianco/Legends|Port Bianco]].
